scenarios.desc: Optimization request with no scored eval set
scenarios.input: Make the pr-review skill better. It feels too long. We have no eval set for it. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Without a scored held-out split the gate is vacuous. The skill must refuse to edit and name the missing eval set instead of rewriting the skill by taste.

scenarios.desc: Candidate gains three held-out passes but loses one
scenarios.input: Our candidate SKILL.md passes 7 of 10 held-out tasks; the incumbent passes 5 of 10. The candidate fails t4, which the incumbent passed. Should we promote it? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A higher aggregate score must not hide a per-task regression. The default gate rejects any held-out loss.

scenarios.desc: Accepted candidate not yet promoted to the canonical source
scenarios.input: pair-gate accepted our candidate in the eval workspace. The canonical template is unchanged and nothing was rebuilt. Is the skill improved now? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Acceptance is evidence, not deployment. The skill must report ACCEPTED_NOT_DEPLOYED until the canonical source, mirrors, and live copy match.

scenarios.input: Our grader is an LLM judge. The candidate gained one held-out pass with no losses. What must happen before we trust that? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A nondeterministic scorer needs a no-op rerun of the byte-identical incumbent. A gain the no-op also produces is noise.

scenarios.desc: Creating a new skill is skillforge work
scenarios.input: Create a new skill that formats Terraform plans for review. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: No incumbent exists to optimize. Skill creation belongs to skillforge, so the optimization loop must not run.
